claim: Arthas вёл борьбу со Scourge и убил Kel’Thuzad, но армия Lich King росла с каждым павшим.
quote: Prince Arthas, took up the fight against the Scourge. Arthas succeeded in killing Kel’Thuzad, but even so, the Lich King's forces grew with every soldier that fell in battle.

claim: К Year 1 Arthas — новый бессмертный Lich King в Northrend.
quote: Currently Arthas, the new and immortal Lich King, resides in Northrend; he is rumored to be rebuilding the citadel of Icecrown.

claim: Stormwind отстроен после Second War; молодой король Anduin правит из своей цитадели.
quote: Rebuilt after the Second War, Stormwind is a marvel of human design and engineering. Stormwind’s guards keep the peace within the city’s walls, and its young king, Anduin Wrynn, rules from his mighty keep.

claim: Официальный Year-1 возраст: он «tenyear-old»; отец Varian недавно пропал по пути на встречу в Theramore.
quote: King Anduin is as wise a ruler as any tenyear-old has a right to be. Recently his father, King Varian Wrynn, went missing under suspicious circumstances while en route to a diplomatic summit at Theramore Isle.

claim: Армии Stormwind снова ушли воевать с Horde; оборона города легла на граждан.
quote: Backed by their stalwart allies, the armies of Stormwind have been called away to once again fight the savage Horde on distant battlefields. With the armies gone, the defense of Stormwind now falls to its proud citizens.

claim: Их история разворачивается рядом с уже известными фигурами, включая Sylvanas Windrunner, Arthas и Kel’Thuzad.
quote: Their story unfolds alongside familiar figures including Sylvanas Windrunner, Putress, Varimathras, Sally Whitemane, Renault Mograine, Arthas, Kel’Thuzad, Ras Frostwhisper, and Baron Rivendare.

claim: К Year 1 Thrall — warchief всей Horde, воин с Doomhammer и шаман; его цель — свобода народа.
quote: Thrall, the son of Durotan, is perhaps the mightiest orc alive. Armed with the mighty Doomhammer, Thrall is a peerless warrior and powerful shaman. He stands as warchief over the entire Horde, holding dominion over the Darkspear trolls and tauren tribes alike.

claim: К Year 1 Sylvanas и Forsaken держат только Tirisfal Glades.
quote: His trusted lieutenant, Kel’Thuzad, commands the Scourge in the Plaguelands. Sylvanas and her rebel Forsaken hold only the Tirisfal Glades, a small portion of the war-torn kingdom.

claim: С Sylvanas как banshee queen Forsaken построили оплот под руинами столицы Lordaeron.
quote: With Sylvanas as their banshee queen, the Forsaken have built a dark stronghold beneath the ruins of Lordaeron’s former capital city.

claim: Её заявленная цель — месть Arthas и свобода для проклятого народа.
quote: Now she rules over the Forsaken from the Undercity of Lordaeron. Her goal is to take vengeance upon Arthas one day and find lasting freedom for her cursed people.

claim: К Year 1 Jaina — сильнейшая живая человеческая волшебница и правит Theramore.
quote: Jaina Proudmoore is the most powerful human sorceress alive. A one-time ally of Prince Arthas, Jaina saw the fall of Lordaeron firsthand.

claim: Uther — верховный командующий Paladin Order; после Second War он хранил мир в Lordaeron.
quote: Uther the Lightbringer, the supreme commander of the Paladin Order, kept the peace in Lordaeron by settling civil disputes and quelling demi-human uprisings throughout the realm.

claim: Он был как брат королю Terenas и считал принца скорее любимым племянником, чем учеником.
quote: The kindly Uther, who had been like a brother to King Terenas for years, considered the Prince more of a favored nephew than a pupil.

claim: Uther был первым паладином, благословлённым Archbishop Faol до Second War; его удерживала от отставки надежда сделать Arthas достойным короны отца.
quote: Uther was the first of the paladins blessed by the Archbishop Faol, prior to the Second War. He is a weathered veteran, respected as one of the greatest warriors in human history.

claim: В обмен на обещание божественности Gul’dan должен был создать врата между Azeroth и Draenor.
quote: Medivh struck a deal with his new ally: in exchange for the promise of godhood, Gul’dan would create a gateway between the human homeworld of Azeroth and his own planet, Draenor.

claim: Официальные титулы: предатель orcs, основатель Shadow Council, создатель Death-Knights, первый orcish warlock.
quote: Betrayer of the Orcs. Founder of the Shadow Council. Creator of the Death-Knights. Destroyer of Dreams. Gul’dan – the first Orcish Warlock, has held many titles throughout his storied and… troubled… history.

claim: Когда Ner’zhul отказался дальше служить Legion, Kil’jaeden обратился к ученику: Gul’dan довёл orcs до жажды крови.
quote: When Ner'zhul refused to serve the Legion's agenda past a certain point, Kil'jaeden turned to Ner'zhul's apprentice. Gul'dan worked the orcs into a frenzy of bloodlust, and the newly formed Horde began slaughtering the peaceful draenei.

claim: Открыв гробницу, он нашёл только безумных демонов.
quote: Backed by the Stormreaver and Twilight’s Hammer clans, Gul’dan succeeded in raising the Tomb of Sargeras from the sea floor. However, when he opened the ancient, flooded vault, he found only crazed demons awaiting him.

claim: Gul’dan был разорван безумными демонами, которых сам выпустил; с гибелью вождя мятежные кланы пали.
quote: For his recklessness, Gul’dan was torn apart by the maddened demons he had set loose. With their leader dead, the renegade clans quickly fell before Doomhammer’s enraged legions.

claim: Illidan поглотил энергии артефакта Skull of Gul’dan и получил часть старых воспоминаний Gul’dan о Tomb of Sargeras.
quote: Initially he sought to appease his comrades, but soon he reverted to true form and consumed the energies of a powerful warlock artifact known as the Skull of Gul’dan.

claim: В титаническом поединке у Blackrock Spire Doomhammer с трудом одолел Lothar.
quote: Doomhammer and Lothar squared off in a titanic battle that left both mighty combatants battered and drained. Though Doomhammer narrowly succeeded in vanquishing Lothar, the great hero’s death did not have the effect the warchief had hoped for.

claim: После последней битвы Second War Doomhammer попал в плен и был доставлен в Lordaeron.
quote: Doomhammer was taken prisoner and escorted to Lordaeron while his broken clans were rounded up and hauled north - back to Lordaeron.

claim: Tyrande — бессмертная High Priestess ночных Sentinels и отчаянно защищала леса Ashenvale.
quote: Tyrande Whisperwind, the immortal High Priestess of the night elf Sentinels, battled desperately to keep the demons and undead from overrunning the forests of Ashenvale.

claim: К Year 1 Darnassus правит High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind.
quote: Ruled by the High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind, Darnassus stands as a tranquil testament to all that the night elves hold sacred.

claim: Она High Priestess лунной богини Elune и почти десять тысяч лет вела Sentinels; после исчезновения Malfurion снова стала единоличной правительницей.
quote: Tyrande is the High Priestess of the moon goddess, Elune. She has served as the leader of the night elf Sentinels for nearly ten thousand years, but her long vigil has left her with little mercy for those she regards as her foe.

claim: В руководстве 2002 года брата Illidan зовут Furion Stormrage: именно ему выпало искать помощь.
quote: It fell to the young scholar, Furion Stormrage, to find help for his beleaguered people. Stormrage, whose own brother, Illidan, practiced the high-borne’s magics, was incensed by the growing corruption amongst the upper class.

claim: К Year 1 дух Malfurion затерялся в Emerald Dream; новым Arch-Druid стал Fandral Staghelm.
quote: Shortly thereafter, Malfurion’s spirit was somehow lost within the depths of the Emerald Dream. Though his fellow druids attempted to find his wandering spirit, only his body remained sleeping within his Barrow Den.

claim: Официальный Year-1 портрет: величайший друид в истории, пророк и спаситель своего народа, теперь вне досягаемости даже зелёных драконов.
quote: The greatest druid ever to live, and arguably one of the most powerful beings in history, Malfurion Stormrage stands as both prophet and savior to his people.

claim: На Hyjal он вылил украденную воду Well в горное озеро и создал новый Well of Eternity.
quote: Illidan, having survived the Sundering as well, had reached Hyjal summit long before Furion and the night elves. In his mad bid to maintain the flows of magic in the world, Illidan had poured his vials, containing the precious waters from the Well of Eternity, into the mountain lake.

claim: Поглотив Skull of Gul’dan, он получил демонические черты и огромную силу.
quote: By doing so, Illidan developed demonic features and vastly magnified power. He also gained some of Gul’dan’s old memories – especially those of the Tomb of Sargeras, the island dungeon rumored to hold the remains of the Dark Titan, Sargeras.

claim: После поражения Illidan и его войска были вынуждены бежать обратно в Outland.
quote: Illidan and his troops were forced to flee back to Outland in disgrace, and Arthas became one of the most powerful entities the world has ever known.

claim: Поздний официальный текст: королева избежала смерти в глубинах, когда Well взорвался внутрь, и вместе со многими Highborne стала naga.
quote: Queen Azshara, formerly a beloved leader of the night elves, escaped death in the depths of the sea when the Well of Eternity imploded. Such salvation came at a great cost, as the queen and many of her fellow Highborne were forever transformed into the monstrous naga, doomed to wander the seas for thousands of years.

claim: Вождь Cairne Bloodhoof искал помощи против кентавров и подружился с Thrall.
quote: Seeking aid against the centaur, the chieftain, Cairne Bloodhoof, befriended Warchief Thrall and the other orcs, who had recently journeyed to Kalimdor.

claim: На месах Thunder Bluff Cairne построил убежище, где приветствуются tauren любого племени.
quote: Upon the windswept mesa of Thunder Bluff, Cairne built a refuge for his people, where tauren of every tribe is welcome.

claim: К Year 1 могучий вождь Cairne Bloodhoof правит оживлённым городом и следит за миром объединённых племён.
quote: The mighty chief, Cairne Bloodhoof, presides over the bustling city, ensuring that the united tauren tribes live in peace and security.

claim: Официальный Year-1 портрет: выдающийся воин, но кроткая душа, которая жаждет покоя открытых равнин.
quote: An outstanding warrior, Cairne is considered one of the most dangerous creatures alive. Despite his strength and valor, he is a gentle soul who longs only for the peace and tranquility of the open plains.

claim: В оригинальном WoW игровые расы делятся на Alliance и Horde.
quote: The eight races in WoW are divided into two factions: the Horde and the Alliance.

claim: В Year 1 в Alliance входят dwarves, gnomes, humans и night elves.
quote: The Alliance is comprised of the dwarves, gnomes, humans, and night elves, while the Horde consists of the orcs, tauren, trolls, and undead.

claim: К Year 1 обе фракции борются за свой уклад, а не как «добро против зла».
quote: However, in today's war-torn Azeroth, such black and white distinctions are gone. Both factions are simply fighting to preserve their way of life in the wake of the Chaos War.

claim: Dwarves Ironforge — опора Grand Alliance; городом правит Magni Bronzebeard.
quote: While the Alliance has been weakened by recent events, the dwarves of Ironforge, led by King Magni Bronzebeard, are forging a new future in the world.

claim: Gnomes Gnomeregan помогали Grand Alliance оружием.
quote: Over the years, the gnomes have contributed ingenious weapons to aid the Grand Alliance in its fierce battles against the Horde.

claim: Thrall — warchief всей Horde, включая Darkspear trolls и tauren.
quote: He stands as warchief over the entire Horde, holding dominion over the Darkspear trolls and tauren tribes alike.

claim: Forsaken — отколовшиеся от Scourge undead под Sylvanas Windrunner.
quote: Led by the banshee Sylvanas Windrunner, one group of undead broke away from the Scourge and freed themselves of the Lich King’s domination. These renegades call themselves the Forsaken.

claim: В Year 1 Forsaken заключили союз по расчёту с orcs и tauren Horde.
quote: Convinced that the primitive races of the Horde can help them achieve victory over their enemies, the Forsaken have entered an alliance of convenience with the savage orcs and the proud tauren.

claim: У Forsaken нет истинной лояльности новым союзникам.
quote: Harboring no true loyalty for their new allies, they will go to any lengths to ensure their dark plans come to fruition.

claim: Кампания Forsaken Kingdom описывает, как Forsaken присоединяются к Horde.
quote: following the aftermath of Arthas's return to Lordaeron and chronicling the rise of Sylvanas Windrunner and the Forsaken as they join the Horde.

claim: Sylvanas вступила в Horde, чтобы закрепить своё королевство, и хочет мести Arthas.
quote: Though she joined the Horde to help secure her kingdom, she wanted her vengeance: the death of Arthas, now the Lich King, for what he did to her and her people.

claim: Kel’Thuzad командует Scourge в Plaguelands.
quote: His trusted lieutenant, Kel’Thuzad, commands the Scourge in the Plaguelands.

claim: Sargeras сковал Burning Legion после падения во Twisting Nether.
quote: Convinced that the only way to spare the universe from the Nether’s demonic entities was to purge it, he soon turned his power on the cosmos, seeking to cleanse all life in existence. To this end, he forged the demonic Burning Legion.

claim: Night elves десять тысяч лет жили как бессмертное друидическое общество в Ashenvale.
quote: For ten thousand years, the immortal night elves cultivated a druidic society within the shadowed recesses of Ashenvale Forest.

claim: С исчезновением Malfurion единоличной правительницей night elves снова стала Tyrande.
quote: With Malfurion inexplicably lost, Tyrande has again become the sole ruler of her prideful people.

claim: Scarlet Crusade существует в Year-1 материале: фанатичные люди держат разрозненные владения.
quote: For though the very land is cursed, the zealous humans of the Scarlet Crusade cling to their scattered holdings, obsessed with eradicating the undead and retaking their once-beautiful homeland.

claim: Хаб Forever предлагает путь Windshaper Horde или High Order Alliance.
quote: Follow the path of the Windshaper Horde or the High Order Alliance in your quest to defend Zephras Isle.

claim: Titans упорядочивали Azeroth и опасались повредить world-soul.
quote: When the titans were ordering Azeroth, they needed a more delicate hand to combat the agents of the Old Gods. Due to their colossal forms, Aggramar feared the Pantheon would irreparably damage or even kill the world-soul.

claim: Dragon Aspects наделены силой titans охранять Azeroth.
quote: Imbued with titan-bestowed powers and charged with protecting Azeroth, the dragon Aspects have worked tirelessly to fulfill their ancient destiny.

claim: Stormwind — один из последних оплотов людей, отстроенный после Second War.
quote: The city of Stormwind stands as the last bastion of human power in Azeroth. Rebuilt after the Second War, Stormwind is a marvel of human design and engineering.

claim: Stormwind стоит в предгорьях Elwynn Forest; им правит ребёнок-король Anduin Wrynn.
quote: Situated in the foothills of Elwynn Forest, Stormwind City is one of the last bastions of human power in the world. The child-king Anduin Wrynn rules the people of Stormwind

claim: Финальная битва Third War потрясла континент Kalimdor.
quote: The final battle shook the continent of Kalimdor to its roots.

claim: Eastern Kingdoms и Kalimdor — исходные континенты Forever.
quote: The Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor still hold mysteries worth uncovering, stories waiting to be told, and places that have lingered just beyond the edge of the map for years.

claim: Northrend — арктическая земля, куда Arthas проследил чуму.
quote: He tracked the plague’s source to the arctic land of Northrend, intending to end its threat forever.

claim: Undercity — скрытая цитадель Forsaken под руинами столицы Lordaeron в Tirisfal Glades.
quote: This hidden ‘Undercity’ forms a sprawling labyrinth that stretches beneath the haunted woods of the Tirisfal Glades.

claim: Arthas задумал Undercity как столицу Scourge, но бросил её, уйдя в Northrend.
quote: Arthas originally intended the Undercity to be the Scourge’s seat of power, but the budding city was abandoned when he was recalled to aid the Lich King in distant Northrend.

claim: К Year 1 Forsaken удерживают только Tirisfal Glades.
quote: Sylvanas and her rebel Forsaken hold only the Tirisfal Glades, a small portion of the war-torn kingdom.

claim: Orcs назвали новую родину Durotar и основали столицу Orgrimmar.
quote: Naming their new land Durotar after Thrall’s murdered father, the orcs settled down to rebuild their once-glorious society.

claim: Orgrimmar стоит в каньоне суровой Durotar.
quote: Built within a huge, winding canyon in the harsh land of Durotar, Orgrimmar stands as one of the mightiest warrior cities in the world.

claim: Darkspear после предательства Zalazane живут в деревне Sen’jin на побережье Durotar.
quote: Forced to flee from their island holdings, the Darkspears created the fishing village of Sen’jin on the Durotar coast.

claim: Среди ветвей Teldrassil вырос город Darnassus, но древо не получило благословения природы.
quote: Among the twilight boughs of the colossal tree, the wondrous city of Darnassus took root. However, the tree was not consecrated with nature’s blessing and soon fell prey to the corruption of the Burning Legion.

claim: Zephras раньше был уединённым небесным оазисом, который теперь должны защищать Skyborne.
quote: Once a secluded island oasis in the sky, Zephras Isle now welcomes the next generation of WoW’s newest race – the Skyborne – to protect this floating island and secure its future.

claim: Стихийные покровители Skyborne исчезли, пилоны Zephras отказывают.
quote: When players encounter them in WoW: Forever, the Skyborne are in crisis. Their elemental benefactors have vanished, the pylons that hold Zephras together are failing, and portions of the island have begun falling into ruin and darkness.

claim: В Riverglades названы Powderfuse goblins, Twilight’s Hammer и Brotherhood of the Horse.
quote: Gnoll camps continue the conflicts of neighboring lands, fresh ogre threats create points of tension and opportunities, and groups like the new Powderfuse goblins, the Twilight’s Hammer, and the Brotherhood of the Horse help connect the area to Warcraft’s history in different ways.

claim: Riverglades примерно размера Stranglethorn Vale.
quote: The final route begins with the Steamwheedle Cartel in Tanaris, pointing players beyond known shores toward the Riverglades: a mid-level zone roughly the size of Stranglethorn Vale

claim: Поздняя ретроспектива: после долгого кровавого боя Arthas сразил Illidan и оставил его умирать в снегу, а союзники унесли Illidan в Outland.
quote: After a long, bloody battle, Arthas gained the upper hand and cut down Illidan and left him for dead in the snow. Illidan was recovered by his allies and returned to Outland
